sources.title: Repology version-comparison mechanism
sources.version_or_date: live page with news dated through 2026-10-23
sources.sections_read: Introductory purpose, version-comparison status legend, recent news.
sources.confirmed: Primary site compares package versions across repositories and distinguishes development, legacy, rolling, unschemed, incorrect and ignored versions. Its live page carries dated 2026 news; no historical pre-cutoff source was opened.
sources.limits: Its heuristic defaults equate some abbreviations, compare alphabetic components by their first letter, and choose particular meanings for ambiguous suffixes; these choices require validation against Python and distribution version conventions, and ordering alone does not prove API compatibility. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C31.json.

sources.title: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 precedence rules
sources.version_or_date: Semantic Versioning 2.0.0; live specification without publication date
sources.sections_read: Specification clauses 2 and 9–11, dependency range example, grammar and version links.
sources.confirmed: SemVer 2.0.0 supplies explicit numeric component and prerelease precedence rules while ignoring build metadata for ordering, and relates compatible releases to a bounded dependency interval. The live specification gives no publication date, so its content is not backdated to 2010.
sources.limits: The three-part grammar does not directly order every existing date-based, custom or distribution-revision spelling, so migration or explicit adapters are still needed; ignoring build metadata and assuming honest compatibility labels must be deliberate policy choices. This is the recorded read scope, not a full-document or deployment validation. Evidence time class: unknown. Original read and any failures remain in runs/B/C31.json.
